faq.title: よくある質問
faq.q1: 対応しているファイル形式は？
faq.a1: DOCXとTXTファイルをEPUBに変換できます。原稿をアップロードし、メタデータ・表紙・スタイルを設定してからダウンロードしてください。
faq.q2: いつでも解約できますか？
faq.a2: はい。プランのアップグレードや解約はいつでも可能で、長期契約は不要です。
faq.q3: アカウントは必要ですか？
faq.a3: 無料プランは登録なしで利用できます。Starter・Proプランは請求と変換履歴のためアカウントが必要です。

Terms.title: 利用規約
Terms.section1Body: EPUB Converter (epubmaker.vercel.app) is a service that converts documents (e.g. DOCX, TXT) to EPUB format. It is operated by an individual developer. By signing up (via email or Google OAuth) and using the service, you agree to these Terms. The service is provided "as is" and you use it at your own responsibility.
Terms.section2Body: You may not: (a) use the service for any illegal purpose or to violate any laws; (b) upload content that infringes others' intellectual property or that you do not have rights to; (c) attempt to reverse engineer, overload, or disrupt the service or its infrastructure; (d) resell or redistribute the service without permission; (e) use automated means to abuse the service beyond normal use.
Terms.section3Body: We may change, limit, or discontinue the service or these Terms at any time. We will try to give notice of material changes where feasible. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. We are not liable for any modification, suspension, or discontinuation of the service.
Terms.section4Body: The service is provided without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service or from conversion results. You are responsible for backing up your data and for how you use converted files.

Privacy.title: プライバシーポリシー
Privacy.section1Body: We collect: (a) Account data: email address, and if you sign up with Google, your Google profile information; (b) Payment-related data: processed by Lemon Squeezy—we do not store full payment card details; (c) Usage data: conversion history, file metadata, and IP address; (d) Error reports: anonymized data may be sent to Sentry for debugging.
Privacy.section2Body: We use this information to: provide and operate the service; manage your account and subscriptions; process payments via Lemon Squeezy; prevent abuse and enforce our terms; improve the service and fix errors.
Privacy.section3Body: We retain account and conversion data while your account is active and as needed for legal or operational purposes. After account deletion, we delete or anonymize your data within a reasonable period.
Privacy.section4Body: We use: Supabase for authentication and storing your account and conversion data; Lemon Squeezy for payment processing; Sentry for error monitoring. We do not sell your personal information.
Privacy.section5Body: You may access, correct, or delete your account and associated data through the account settings. For payment or subscription issues, you can use the Lemon Squeezy customer portal.
Privacy.section6Body: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact us via the contact method provided on epubmaker.vercel.app.

Refund.title: 返金ポリシー
Refund.section1Body: Subscriptions are billed through Lemon Squeezy. You may cancel at any time from the billing portal. Refunds are handled according to Lemon Squeezy's policy.
Refund.section2Body: For one-time pay-per-use purchases, refunds may be considered if the conversion clearly failed due to a service error. Refunds are not provided for user error. Contact us with your order or conversion details.
Refund.section3Body: Refund requests should be sent via the contact method on epubmaker.vercel.app. We will respond within a reasonable time. Approved refunds will be processed via Lemon Squeezy.
